objective: Determine whether a chronology-clean helper can improve the existing H12 MNQ logistic model's real weekly trading economics without score pumping, post-hoc threshold selection, direction inversion, or contemporaneous NQ assistance.

challengers.confidence_trust_q65: Base direction is retained only when chronology-clean prior inner-OOF base confidence is at or above its q65 cut; otherwise abstain.
challengers.local_state_trust_q65: A class-balanced logistic correctness helper consumes local MNQ state/regime features plus base prediction/confidence, is trained only on chronology-clean prior inner-OOF base predictions, and may retain or abstain only. It cannot invert or replace direction. Its q65 trust cut is fit only on prior inner-OOF helper probabilities.

chronology.outer_evaluation: fixed quarterly walk-forward 2023-07 through 2025-12 with H12 purge
chronology.helper_training: four chronological inner OOF folds inside each outer training set
forbidden: use outer OOS outcomes to choose thresholds or features
drop bad weeks, phases, years, or regimes after inspection

weekly_economic_contract.phase_contract: all non-overlapping UTC H12 phase streams; none selected post-hoc
required_metrics: max drawdown of cumulative weekly phase medians

advance_rule: At both 1-point and 2-point round-trip costs, challenger must have positive paired median delta, paired win fraction above 0.50, positive-week fraction no worse than baseline, p10 no worse than baseline, bottom-10-percent mean no worse than baseline, and max drawdown no worse than baseline. All checks must pass. Failure is a rejection/rework result, not a threshold-tuning invitation.
nq_boundary: NQ is reserved for later external/pre-2019 relationship validation only if a helper first passes the frozen MNQ rule. NQ must not train or tune this MNQ helper and must not be used as a contemporaneous score-boosting feature in this experiment.
